exceptions.reason: Only glob 13.0.7 under @expo/fingerprint is affected; 14.0.4 is the fixed release used by every other Expo package. The flaw lets a walk keep reading directories after its caller aborts it, which needs a caller that passes an AbortSignal; @expo/fingerprint walks the repository with fixed local patterns and passes no signal. It runs only for native build fingerprints (expo-updates or run:android/run:ios); the learner uses neither, and glob is not in the shipped web bundle (checked against the export source map).
exceptions.upstream: Fixed only in glob 14.0.2. @expo/fingerprint 0.20.15 (the SDK 57 line) and 0.21.9 (latest) still require glob ^13.0.0, so no Expo upgrade removes it. A semver-major npm override is the only other route, and scripts/public-policy.mjs refuses manifest overrides.

exceptions.reason: Only minimatch 10.2.6, reached through @expo/fingerprint and glob 13.0.7 beneath it, is affected; 11.0.5 is fixed. The denial of service needs an attacker-controlled glob pattern. @expo/fingerprint matches paths against local patterns from the repository's own Expo configuration during native build fingerprints only; no request, learner or course input reaches it, the learner runs no native builds, and minimatch is not in the shipped web bundle (checked against the export source map).
exceptions.upstream: Fixed only in minimatch 11.0.1. @expo/fingerprint 0.20.15 (the SDK 57 line) and 0.21.9 (latest) still require minimatch ^10.2.2, and glob 13 requires ^10.2.2, so no Expo upgrade removes it. A semver-major npm override is the only other route, and scripts/public-policy.mjs refuses manifest overrides.
